learning_goals: Strengthen reading, writing, math, and science skills at grade 4 level
Increase fluency and sophistication in both English and Spanish
Build grade-level academic vocabulary in both languages
Engage in inquiry, critical thinking and cross-discipline integration

standards_sources: North Carolina Standard Course of Study for English Language Arts, Mathematics, Science
North Carolina World Language Essential Standards

instructional_preferences.activity_length: Short and engaging (10–20 minutes each prompt)

deliverables: Hands-on or interactive components (drawing, solving, presenting)
Oral and written expression opportunities in both languages
Real-world contexts in math and science
Regular review and reinforcement of learned concepts
Use of manipulatives or physical materials when helpful

family_goals: Start basic research projects with simple citations
Foster a love of science through experiments and nature exploration
Promote critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Provide clear empathy and social skills development opportunities
Build stronger organizational skills for assignments and materials
Support emotional regulation strategies during challenging tasks
Cultivate curiosity and a growth mindset towards learning
Balance structured lessons with free exploration time
support_needs: dysgraphia accommodations such as graph paper and typing option
access to manipulatives for math concepts
regular communication with parents on progress and challenges
ideas for integrating interests into lessons
tips for fostering independence in learning
assessment_preferences: project presentations to family twice per month
social_learning: weekly co-op science lab
monthly museum visits
history reenactment calls with cousin and other family members
periodic virtual language exchanges with Spanish-speaking pen pals
local homeschool group field trips
community service projects related to learning topics
group storytelling or drama activities
collaborative art or building projects
nature walks with observation and journaling with peers
book clubs or reading circles
math games or competitions with friends
science fairs or exhibitions
cultural celebrations or cooking activities in Spanish
virtual meetups for sharing research projects
peer review sessions for writing assignments
group problem-solving challenges
language practice games with siblings or friends
team sports or physical activities to build social skills
music or dance activities from Spanish-speaking cultures
family storytelling nights incorporating learned themes
show-and-tell sessions for projects completed
joint art projects reflecting cultural studies
collaborative science experiments or observations
shared reading time with discussion questions
partner math problem-solving activities
group field trips to local historical sites
virtual cultural exchange presentations
joint nature exploration and documentation
team-based educational games or challenges
family cooking nights featuring ethnic recipes
additional_notes: sensitive to loud noises; provide calming playlist options
connect math to real-world situations when possible

English.prompt: Reading Literature: Generate a story with dialogue and theme. Include 5 comprehension and 3 vocabulary questions.

Spanish.prompt: Interpersonal: Write a dialogue about daily routine. Include vocabulary and 3 follow-up questions in Spanish.

Math.prompt: Place Value: Provide 5 problems on reading, writing, and comparing multi-digit numbers. Include 2 bonus problems on rounding.

Science.prompt: Inquiry: Create an experiment about how different materials conduct heat. Include materials list, hypothesis question, and analysis chart.

English.prompt: Writing Opinion: Provide a prompt requiring a clearly stated opinion, supporting reasons, and linking words. Include 3 reflection questions.

Spanish.prompt: Vocabulary: Provide themed Spanish vocabulary with 10 new words, 5 example sentences, and a matching activity.

Math.prompt: Multiplication: Generate 4 two-digit by one-digit and 2 multi-step word problems. Include space to show work.

Science.prompt: Life Science: Provide reading on ecosystems or animal adaptations with 5 follow-up questions and 1 drawing task.

English.prompt: Reading Info: Generate a nonfiction passage about a science or social studies topic with 5 comprehension and 3 practice questions.

Spanish.prompt: Interpretive: Create a Spanish paragraph (~100 words) with 5 comprehension and 2 inference questions.

Math.prompt: Division: Write 5 word problems with remainders. Ask students to explain their reasoning in one sentence.

Science.prompt: Earth Science: Create a task comparing types of rocks or soils. Include sorting activity and 3 practice questions.

English.prompt: Language: Create grammar practice involving complex sentences, possessives, and plural rules. Provide 4 sample sentences to correct or complete.

Spanish.prompt: Grammar: Offer verb conjugation practice in present tense and irregular forms. Include 4 fill-in-the-blank sentences.

Math.prompt: Fractions: Create fraction comparison and equivalent fraction tasks with visuals. Include 3 questions using number lines.

Science.prompt: Physical Science: Build a lesson on forces and motion. Include a toy car investigation and 3 critical thinking questions.

English.prompt: Writing Narrative: Prompt a story with a clear beginning, rising action, climax, and resolution. Include 2 visual organizer templates.

Spanish.prompt: Writing: Prompt for a paragraph about a family tradition or favorite activity in Spanish. Include 2 sentence starters.

Math.prompt: Measurement: Write problems involving perimeter, area, and elapsed time. Include 1 real-world scenario.

Science.prompt: Energy: Prompt a task on light or sound energy with diagrams. Include vocabulary and 3 questions.

English.prompt: Speaking & Listening: Design a retelling/presentation task using note cards and visual prompts. Include a rubric and 2 reflection questions.

Spanish.prompt: Presentational: Task student to prepare a short speech in Spanish about a personal interest. Include checklist and 2 practice lines.

Math.prompt: Geometry: Task students with identifying lines, angles, and classifying shapes. Include diagrams and 4 multiple choice questions.

Science.prompt: Weather/Climate: Provide a reading on weather patterns and graphing activity using real data. Include 4 practice questions.

English.prompt: Writing Research: Create a structured research prompt with a sample topic, note-taking chart, and 4 questions to guide inquiry.

Spanish.prompt: Culture: Present a mini reading in Spanish about a Hispanic holiday or custom. Include 3 comprehension questions.

Math.prompt: Data: Provide bar graph and line plot interpretation problems. Include 2 questions where students create their own graph.

Science.prompt: Human Impact: Ask students to brainstorm and categorize ways humans affect Earth. Include drawing + 2 short responses.
